result.title: JoVox: Joint Hierarchical Flow Matching for Lightweight Voxel Generation
result.summary: Generating high-fidelity voxels while keeping their lightweight nature remains an open problem in computer vision. Current generators are either high-fidelity but computationally heavy, or lightweight but of lower fidelity. Hierarchical methods keep the lightweight nature of voxels. However, their coarse levels, which decide where all finer cells can appear, are generated with the least information about the shape and are never revisited, so they are often plausible but wrong. Our key insight is to let finer cells take part in deciding coarse cells. To this end, we propose JoVox, a discrete flow matching framework that learns the joint distribution of all levels of the voxel hierarchy, instead of a separate distribution for each level, so that coarse cells can be predicted with finer cells already generated nearby. Within this framework, we further introduce a two-level prediction, which outputs the cells two levels finer at once instead of one level finer, halving the number of levels that the network processes and yielding voxels of higher fidelity. We also introduce an unmasking strategy that revisits early decisions once finer cells are generated and corrects inconsistencies in masked diffusion models. Our framework outperforms the baselines on both unconditional and image-conditioned voxel generation. Compared with the current state-of-the-art TRELLIS.2, we achieve 8x higher training throughput, 1/15 of the FLOPs in a forward pass, train on 4 vs. 32 GPUs, and obtain higher quality with an 11% lower Chamfer distance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 JoVox，用离散 flow matching 学习体素层级中所有层次的联合分布，使细粒度体素参与决定粗粒度体素，并引入两级预测与可在细化后回溯修正早期决策的 unmasking 策略，实现轻量高保真体素生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「细化后再重访并纠正早期粗层决策」的 unmasking 与跨层联合分布，可能为 LVR 中多尺度 latent 状态更新和早期承诺的修正提供可供核查的方法线索，但论文面向 3D 生成，迁移性待评估。
